message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 79.4% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in hacking and system developer. I want to become a Solutions Architect. My family can afford at most about USD 8500 per year. I live in Chennai. I'm open to going abroad.

other_constraints: Interested in hacking and system developer roles

explanation:
This MSc Cloud Computing program is highly relevant to your goal of becoming a Solutions Architect and System Developer. Located in Germany, it offers strong technical skills in networking and cloud computing at a very affordable annual tuition of $1950. Since you have an IT/CS background, the requirement for a CS background is met. The main trade-off here is that while the tuition is excellent, the placement rate stands at 67%.

Given your interest in hacking, this MSc Information Security program provides specialized knowledge in cybersecurity. It requires a CS background and has an acceptable minimum grade requirement of 75%. While the tuition is $3800, it directly addresses your technical interest in security. The trade-off is that this program is located in India rather than Germany.

The MSc Software Engineering program provides a robust foundation for system development and aligns well with your full stack background. Located in Germany, it is an excellent choice for deepening your technical expertise. The tuition of $3850 is manageable within your budget, though it is higher than some other German options. This program offers strong core engineering skills necessary for advanced roles.

This MSc IT Management degree is ideal for transitioning into a Solutions Architect role by blending technical knowledge with business understanding. It has an extremely low annual tuition of $950 and boasts a high placement rate of 91%. The main trade-off to consider is that the minimum required grade (80%) is slightly above your current academic average of 79.4%.

This MSc Software Quality Engineering program offers a strong technical focus with an accessible minimum grade requirement of 59%. Located in Germany and costing $3450 annually, it is well within your financial constraints. While the curriculum focuses specifically on QA testing, this deep dive into software reliability provides valuable skills for any system developer role. The trade-off is that its scope is narrower than a general software engineering degree.
